column1: # comment: Sexuality alignments — sexual/romantic orientation values to Homosaurus (the authoritative LGBTQ+ vocabulary) and the sexual-orientation property to Wikidata P91. GMEOW applies the SPLIT-ATTRACTION model (sexual orientation and romantic orientation are separate axes); most external vocabularies do NOT distinguish them, so romantic-orientation values map only to the few Homosaurus romantic terms and are otherwise canonical. schema.org and FOAF have no orientation term — orientation is a documented lossy drop at the projection layer. Only identifiers VERIFIED against Homosaurus are mapped; the value vocab is OPEN and extends here as IDs are curated. The reified, self-asserted, co-equal gmeow:IdentityFacet machinery is CANONICAL.
